Aisha Patel: Hey team — need a quick primary swap for tonight 18:00–22:00 UTC. Flight is delayed at ORD, stuck at gate. There's a lingering P2 'embeddings latency flapper' that's currently stable but could reoccur during peak. Can @Tom Nguyen take primary? I can warm-shadow until 20:00 and stay reachable until 20:30.

Tom Nguyen: I can take primary for 18:00–22:00. Ack. Do you have the quick runbook pointer and any checklist? Also what's the current cache hit rate?

Aisha Patel: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-flapper — main things: check worker restarts, cache eviction, and recent kernel rollouts. Current prefix cache hit ~87% (console). I'll paste a short handoff checklist below.

Aisha Patel: ```
Handoff checklist:
- Confirm pager assignment -> set primary to Tom
- Warm shadow: Aisha watches channels + pager forwarding until 20:00
- Confirm cache hit rate >= 80% (85% preferred)
- If flapper recurs: scale dedicated pool +1 and notify infra-sre
- If error rate >2% for 2m -> escalate to #inc-embed and page infra-sre
```

oncall-bot: oncall-bot automated: Pager forwarded & pending assignment change detected.

Ben Russell: I can be secondary backup 18:00–02:00 if needed. Phone +1-555-0100. Will keep an eye on error budgets and token costs.

Marta Lopez: I can shadow the first 30m (18:00–18:30) remotely and run through telemetry checks (latency p95, cache hit, KV evictions). Will also watch slow path logs.

Aisha Patel: Assigning roles for tonight: Tom primary (18:00–22:00), Ben secondary, Marta shadow 18:00–18:30, Aisha warm-shadow until 20:00. Tom pls ack and update pager.

Tom Nguyen: Ack. Running local handoff helper: `./scripts/oncall assign --primary tom` then `./scripts/oncall forward-pager --from aisha --to tom --until 22:00`. I'll also set a temporary alert suppression for noisy deploy-related alerts.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot automated: primary updated -> Tom Nguyen; secondary -> Ben Russell. Pager routing updated.

Marta Lopez: :thumbsup: starting observation at 17:55 UTC. Quick note — I saw cache eviction spike yesterday; I'd prefer to temporarily lower eviction threshold to 5% for the next 2h if we get noise.

Ben Russell: If we see >2% error rate on embeddings for 2 consecutive minutes, escalate to infra-sre and open #inc-embed. Also if scaling is performed, annotate the decision in the runbook with the `scale:increment` tag.

Aisha Patel: Added runbook link and #inc-embed to pinned items in the channel. Leaving laptop for escalation creds. Thanks all — I gotta go to the gate now, I'll monitor but expect brief gaps.

Tom Nguyen: Roger. I'll take primary and update post-handoff status here if anything changes. Will call infra-sre on scaling. Handoff confirmed.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot automated: Handoff confirmed for thread 7788122334. Coverage window 18:00–22:00 UTC. Link to handoff log: https://redwood.internal/handoffs/7788122334

Tom Nguyen: Closing note — I'll keep the temp threshold notes in the runbook under 'quick-handoffs' so future swaps are faster. Thanks everyone.
